extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Earth is our home — it has land (where we walk, build, farm) and water (rivers, ponds, sea). (2) Weather is what the sky is like — sunny, cloudy, rainy, windy. (3) Weather changes what we wear — sunny day = cotton clothes + cap, rainy day = raincoat + umbrella, cold day = sweater + jacket. (4) Weather changes what we do — sunny = play outside, rainy = stay dry, windy = fly kite. Misconceptions: 'Earth is only land' (Earth has both land and water), 'weather is the same every day' (weather changes daily), 'we can wear anything in any weather' (rainy = raincoat, sunny = cotton, cold = sweater). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function EarthWeatherGame), NOT export default. Export interface EarthWeatherGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
